qualification_contract: Exact-stack v2 HfMatrixProfile records carry explicit endpoint-qualified DirectJkTopologyProfile selections inside their AO/batch domain. Product calibration alone never implies a resident-ERI crossover or queue schedule.

Persistent queue domains are runtime-selectable within compiler-emitted bounds; allocation and reset keep the bounded compiled superset. Defaults retain force=7 and Fock=6, and no new measured production winner is shipped.

A topology promotion requires complete resident-versus-actual-screened-quartet endpoint evidence, expected Fock reuse and geometry-rebuild frequency, setup/storage accounting and independent scientific gates. Source-matched default regression evidence is distinct from synthetic-profile legality tests.
